messages:
Sophie (AM): Heads-up — Proxima DataOps just pinged me. They're looking to add two new teams (Search + DataOps) onto our API this quarter. Want embeddings for semantic search and a streaming chat endpoint. They expect ~3x token throughput on weekdays if pilot goes well. Renewal is 87 days out, so this feels like an expansion + renewal play. @Maria (CS) any immediate churn risk?
Maria (CS): Thanks Sophie. At a glance account health looks OK (recent NPS 8). But adding new teams and heavy embeddings could spike costs. Need to confirm their traffic pattern and dataset sizes.
Sophie (AM): They mentioned ~200k queries/day initially, mostly 512-1024 token windows. Also asked about batch pricing and dedicated capacity options.
Omar (SE): Quick thoughts — we can support this but recommend: quantized model variant for embeddings, batching + KV prefix caching for chat, and a Dedicated pool for predictable p50 p99. Need sample workload and a short prompt set to estimate cost. Can @Lee (Onboarding) run a 2-week pilot environment? :eyes:
Lee (Onboarding): Yep — I can run a pilot. Proposed plan: week1 onboarding + SDK walkthrough, week2 eval harness and regression tests, week3 scale test. Need contact from their infra to share sample logs and an SRE liaison.
Daniel (Product): Noted product asks: model fallback routing (prefer smaller fallback for embeddings) and a cheaper batch-only endpoint for high-throughput embedding jobs. I'll log a feature note. Filing internal issue so we don't lose this.
Sophie (AM): They also want an SLA target of ~150ms p50 for chat; they'll consider Dedicated if we can meet latency and cost targets.
Maria (CS): Action items: 1) Get sample traffic + prompt set from Proxima (Sophie to ask) 2) SE to produce cost/latency estimate and recommended config (Omar) 3) Onboarding to schedule pilot (Lee) 4) Flag renewal + exec touchpoint (Sophie + ops-bot).
Omar (SE): Draft config I want to test against their samples:
```
preferred_config:
  model_variant: redwood-quant-4bit
  batching:
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
    max_concurrency: 48
  kv_cache: true
  embedding_batch_size: 512
```
Omar (SE): Also will run a quick cost sim with our Optimize tooling; should have numbers in 48 hrs.
Lee (Onboarding): I'll create a shared Runbook and invite their infra + our SEs. Propose kickoff Wed 10am PT. calendarbot: Event created for 2026-04-01 10:00 PT — "Proxima pilot kickoff".
ops-bot: Renewal alert created: Proxima renewal date 2026-06-15 — 87 days out. Added to "at-risk-renewals" dashboard.
Sophie (AM): I'll request sample dataset and ask them to confirm teams/users that need access. Also will loop in finance for a preliminary cost estimate.
Maria (CS): Low immediate churn risk but this is a high expansion opportunity. Recommend an executive summary for renewals folder and a brief ROI calc to present during pilot.
Daniel (Product): I'll prioritize routing/fallback feasibility check with runtime team; if we can implement a graceful fallback within their pilot window, that's a big plus.
Sophie (AM): Perfect — assigning owners. Will post updates here after kickoff. :rocket:
